description: Testbed floor: fio 4 KiB QD1 direct random read and 4 KiB QD1 write+fdatasync on each node's experiment XFS, and a TCP ping-pong A->B on the experiment link. With nvme_tcp, B also exports a file-backed nvmet namespace on its XFS over the experiment link and A reads it through kernel nvme-tcp (disable per campaign with nodes config r0_nvme_tcp false).

r6615.note: SMT off (setup.sh nosmt): 32 physical cores; irq, daemon and guest sets on distinct cores, 24-31 idle

c6525-25g.note: SMT off (setup.sh nosmt): 16 physical cores; eight guest cores, so the g16 units and the 16-image burst are not in this node type's plan

loopback-8.note: development: both members on one 8-vCPU VM, as in the 2026-11-13 harness validation
